_comment: V14 - pinned SHA-256 digests of the artifacts this service deserialises.
joblib.load() unpickles, which executes arbitrary code chosen by the file,
so app.py verifies these digests before loading and refuses to start on a
mismatch. This file is deliberately tracked in git: a digest is not a secret,
and version control makes any change to a pin visible in review.
Regenerate after retraining with: python tools/checksum_artifacts.py --write
